title: Siree Raag, First Mehla:
summary: Comparison is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
lifeApplication: Bring the mind back from the other person to the state of your own heart. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.lifeApplication: Comparison becomes more truthful when siree Raag, First Mehla:.

evidence.turn: Comparison steadies when o Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to the one who beholds, and inspires.
evidence.practicalImplication: Bring the mind back from the other person to the state of your own heart. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
